archetypes.name: Merfolk
archetypes.plan: Build around Shapers of Nature: Build a critical mass of Merfolk, place counters where they enable attacks, and use evasion to break board stalls.

archetypes.name: Pirates
archetypes.plan: Build around Dire Fleet Captain: Attack with evasive Pirates, use raid and Treasure to maintain tempo, and remove blockers before they stabilize.

archetypes.name: Vampires
archetypes.plan: Build around Call to the Feast: Gain life and create Vampire tokens, then use tribal payoffs to turn the growing board into an evasive attack.

archetypes.name: Dinosaurs
archetypes.plan: Build around Raging Swordtooth: Ramp into oversized Dinosaurs, exploit enrage when profitable, and use trample to convert size into damage.
